newsitem.title: GERMANY: New Deutsche BA head charged to make profits.
newsitem.headline: New Deutsche BA head charged to make profits.

text.p: Deutsche BA, in which British Airways has a 49 percent stake, has appointed Carl Michel as managing director with effect from April 1.

BA said the 33-year-old will be responsible for bringing the airline into profit. Deutsche BA launched an aggressive price-cutting attack on Lufthansa this winter as part of its new concentration on the domestic German market gaining market share but has not returned to profits.
It has dropped all international services except for Gatwick flights and added the lucrative Hamburg-Munich route to its network a company statement said.
